notes.title: Patch fix. 25.09.25
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/e55d027fff307b72012d0f9181fa61078790d0b4.png"][/img][/p][p]Stalkers![/p][p][/p][p]We present you a list of changes included in today's patch fix:
[/p][p]– Fixed an issue related to incorrect behavior of base guards.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue where clanless players and players in level 1 and 2 clans could respawn at the attacking side's campfires.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue where level 2 clans had a safe zone effect on attacking side campfires.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue where bullets would fly incorrectly when shooting with a Freezing effect.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue where the barbed wire on Vesuvius and the low fence in the Black Forest were not shot through.
[/p][p]– Fixed an issue related to the decrease in sliding speed after a jump.
[/p][p]– Fixed an issue where the killer's name in chat was not highlighted in blue.
[/p][p]– Fixed an issue where the weapon jam message would appear only after pressing LMB again.
[/p][p]– Fixed an issue related to updating the table of clan members when a member logs into the game.[/p][p][/p][p]– Removed the firing delay for the Portable Flamethrower “Shorty”.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue related to the quest “Morozov’s Box”.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue related to the quest “Goods from Butcher”.
[/p][p]– Fixed an issue where markers would not disappear from the map after completing the daily quest "Lost in three pines."[/p][p][/p][p]– The items "One ticket to Usov" and "One Ticket to Tunguska" are now bound to character.[/p][p][/p][p]– Renamed the item "Old ship nail" to "Old ship bracket".[/p][p][/p][p]– Shtaket was moved slightly to make it easier to interact with him.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed the display of the icon for completely deleting an item in the Inventory window.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue related to the display of some NPCs on the map.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue related to the message about damage dealt to a character for the English localization.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed a visual issue where the quantity of an item would not decrease after being partially moved from Account Storage, or where the item would not disappear from Account Storage after being fully moved to the inventory. This issue only affected Steam players.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed localization of some windows and dialogues.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed various typos in the text.[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]Stay Out Team[/p]

notes.title: Patch fix. 04.09.25
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/4db0aef05d4f2dbfaa112d7388fd8175e3df6fb8.png"][/img][/p][p]Stalkers![/p][p][/p][p]We present you a list of changes included in today's patch fix:[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue where Exchanger would not accept “Ice” artifacts with a charge lower than 49%.[/p][p][/p][p]If you had “Ice” artifacts with an unacceptable charge for exchange, and they disappeared before this update was released, please contact our Technical Support.
[/p][p]Website (required an individual registration): [url="https://stalkeronline.helpdeskeddy.com/en"]https://stalkeronline.helpdeskeddy.com/en[/url][/p][p]E-mail: support@stalker.so[/p][p][/p][p]– Renamed one of two items with the same name "Part of an old ship rigging" to "Block of an old ship rigging".[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue where Valday could not remove the negative effect from Repey needle.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue where George Karasev did not issue an OZK suit and a U-2K respirator for completing a daily quest.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed issues with markers when completing daily quests in Liubech, when they remained on the map after the quests were cancelled.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue where the item information pop-up would appear outside the exchange window.[/p][p][/p][p]– Slightly shifted the respawn point at the last stage of the solo dungeon “Library” so that the character is not affected by the Discharger anomaly upon respawn.[/p][p][/p][p]– Changed the conditions for transporting for Palych and Mykola Afanasyich:[/p][list][*][p]From Airport to Vesuvius – 45 level;[/p][/*][*][p]From Airport to Tunguska – 55 level;[/p][/*][*][p]From Airport to New Land, Northern Island – 70 level;[/p][/*][*][p]From Airport to Black Forest – 75 level;[/p][/*][/list][p]The conditions for having a reputation with “UNION” remain unchanged.[/p][p][/p][p]– Removed the stun effect on hit from Forsakens in Liubech.
[/p][p]– Fixed localization of some NPCs, dialogues and items.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed various typos in the text.[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,
Stay Out Team[/p]

notes.content:

[/p][p]– Fixed localization of some NPCs and dialogues.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed various typos in the text.[/p][p][/p][p]– Added NPC “Anomaly researcher” next to Exchanger, with whom you can exchange “Ice” artifacts. Exchanger again accepts "Belochka" candies for exchange.

notes.title: Patch fix. 14.08.25
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/345e871c92a3e7c4adca2d9b856d9520dbedabd3.png"][/img][/p][p]Stalkers![/p][p][/p][p]We present you a list of changes included in today's patch fix:[/p][p][/p][p]– Changed the cost in in-game rubles and the OG of the guide at the “Sawmill” and “Treatment Plant” fortification points.[/p][p][/p][p]– Now in the Liubech solo dungeon, the light from the red lamps on the first floor turns off without delay.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue where it was impossible to have a dialogue with Shtaket, even if there were quests that required talking to him.[/p][p][/p][p]Note: An exception is the situation when, during the "Battle for Liubech" story chapter, a curfew is declared in the city.
[/p][p]– Now the part-time job with Sergeant Burnt correctly rewards with reputation with the “UNION”.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed the name of the effect of the artifact Rubber β.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue where the KIH-5 did not protect against the effects of mushroom spores.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue related to the respawn window for the attacking side at the fortification points of New Land, Southern Island.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue where the dragged item would be dropped and the pop-up window with brief information would disappear while loading the magazine.
[/p][p]– Fixed an issue related to light in the “Hive” dungeon.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue where items purchased from the in-game store would disappear after completing the tutorial.
[/p][p]– Fixed an issue where it was impossible to take the “Witches boilers” quest.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue where it was impossible to use the benches of Maxim Anatolievich and Ex-Master of Distillery.
[/p][p]– Fixed localization of some NPCs, dialogues and locations.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed various typos in the text.[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]Stay Out Team[/p]

notes.content:

notes.title: Patch fix. 22.07.25
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/9bf88f5ff351c0b9dc6afa99f73be38e176e8fd4.png"][/img][/p][p]Stalkers!

We present you a list of changes included in today's patch fix:
[/p][p]– The in-game event “Cool Heat” is already on all project servers!
[/p][p]Dates of the event: [b]22.07 - 19.08[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Help scientists study new anomalous formations and get valuable rewards![/p][p][/p][p]Also, they say that an unusual container with a new suit has appeared in the Zone and in-game store...

To participate in the event, you need to talk to the NPC "Anomaly Researcher", who are located in:[/p][list][*][p]Gourmet village (Liubech Outskirts, square E6-3)[/p][/*][*][p]Radio Tower (Vesuvius, square E2-1)[/p][/*][*][p]Konukovo Airport (Airport, square C2-4)[/p][/*][*][p]Radius village (Tunguska, square C2-3)[/p][/*][*][p]Port (New Land, Northern Island, square B4-3)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]– Also, in honor of the release of the update and the start of the event, we are attaching a nice promotional code that will definitely make your stay in the Zone easier!

Promocode: [b]SO_SUMMER_25[/b][/p][p][/p][p]You can activate this promotional code in the main menu by selecting the “Promocode” button.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Please note:[/b] all items are personal and will be assigned to the character you picked them up from! They cannot be transferred or sold.
[/p][p]You can pick up items at any respawn point by opening the corresponding tab in your inventory.[/p][p]The promocode can be activated until [b]27.07.25 23:59[/b] (Moscow time).[/p][p][/p][p]– Reduced the amount of “Ice” artefacts required to exchange for event rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]– Returned the previous colors of the effect icons.[/p][p]
– Renamed and localized into Chinese achievements for Liubech solo dungeon.
[/p][p]– Reduced the maximum number of players in clans. Players over the limit will be automatically excluded from the clan.[/p][list][*][p]Level 1: 10 people[/p][/*][*][p]Level 2: 25 people[/p][/*][*][p]Level 3: 50 people[/p][/*][*][p]Level 4: 75 people[/p][/*][*][p]Level 5: 100 people[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]– Reset Clan Points for all clans. Player's personal CP remains intact.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue with incorrect display of rewards for the PvP season.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue with capture map at Tunguska base.[/p][p][/p][p]– Now in the Liubech solo dungeon, the electrified floor after stage 2 no longer breaks the player's equipment.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue related to incorrect chances of successful modification of the following weapons:[/p][list][*][p]Accuracy international L96A1;[/p][/*][*][p]AK-107;[/p][/*][*][p]VSS;[/p][/*][/list][p]
– Decreased penetration for 7.62x39 T45M with trace bullet (yellow) ammo: 190 >>> 180.[/p][p][/p][p]– Added localization of the exchange with Supply manager Polishchuk into Chinese.[/p][p][/p][p]– Added Honey fungus in exchange for Supply manager Polishchuk.
[/p][p]– Fixed an issue that could prevent the interaction area of soil samples from being displayed in the “Routine inspection” quest.[/p][p]
– Fixed an issue due to which Technician in the Liubech bomb shelter could reset the progress of the quest "Abandon hope all ye who enter here".
[/p][p]– Now, instead of Small spider, a Spider appears in the “Tractor” event.
[/p][p]– Fixed an issue related to incorrect work of the “Undercover work” clan skill.[/p][p]
– Fixed an issue with incorrect display of quest timers for Imarek in the English localization.

Sincerely,
Stay Out Team[/p]

notes.title: Patch fix. 17.07.25
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/78e95c4df7573069a2dc9a65084876786adf3bec.png"][/img][/p][p]Stalkers![/p][p]
We present you a list of changes included in today's patch fix:

– Added a respawn point to the faction headquarters.[/p][p]
– Now you can pick up items from your account storage at the faction headquarters.[/p][p]
– Now clan recruitment announcements can be edited and deleted. Clan Points are required for editing.[/p][p]
– Fixed an issue related to incorrect behavior of NPCs in dynamic events when shooting at them.[/p][p]

– Now you can contact Sergeant Burnt again for the "Artifact call" quest.[/p][p]
– Now the quest "Samples from spiders" works correctly. If this quest was taken before the patch fix was released, you must abandon the quest and try to take it again.[/p][p]
– Fixed issues with the "Resetting the voltage" quest. Players who encountered issues while completing this quest should approach NPC Valera and talk to him, after which the quest will be re-taken.[/p][p]

Stay Out Team[/p]

notes.title: Patch fix. 16.07.25
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/20a8707a9d23375335c0be3dd3fedfc50054cfce.png"][/img][/p][p]Stalkers![/p][p]We present you a list of changes included in today's patch fix:[/p][p]– Disabled the radius display for crows.[/p][p]– Corrected the description of gift Premium subscriptions.[/p][p]– Fixed an issue that allowed players to leave Liubech with the artifact "Body". All players who left the city with the artifact will be returned to Liubech to turn in the quest.[/p][p]– Fixed an issue where the Anomalous Snowdrop could be obtained from the Hive Guardian.[/p][p]– Fixed an issue with the quest equipment for the "Lost in three pines" quest. Players who were unable to turn in the equipment during the quest must approach George Karasev and talk to him – then the equipment will be returned.[/p][p]– Added actions to quest items for use in the "Vaccination against the unknown" and "Resetting the voltage" quests for English and Chinese localizations.[/p][p]– “Black Market” clan is no longer at war with the “UNION” clan.[/p][p]– Now the lab table near Doctor Zinoviev works correctly.[/p][p]– Fixed an issue that made it impossible to turn in the “Eagle Bolt” quest to Ivy.[/p][p]– Fixed an issue that made it impossible to complete the "Fedor's Stash" quest.[/p][p]– Fixed an issue that made it impossible to complete the “Little mouse” quest.[/p][p]– Added localization of the container in the Liubech solo dungeon.[/p][p]– Reduced the movement speed of Small spider.[/p][p]– Now, instead of Small spider, a Spider appears in the “TV” event.[/p][p]– Adjusted the firing sounds of the H&K MP5 SD.[/p][p]– Adjusted the sounds of the waterfall in the Airport.[/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]Stay Out Team[/p]

notes.title: Patch fix. 15.07.25
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/939c726d1cade731b52348f44df5968aa9ac8dd9.png"][/img][/p][p]Stalkers![/p][p][/p][p]We present you a list of changes included in today's patch fix:[/p][p][/p][p]– Removed NPC "Guide" in Gourmet Village.[/p][p][/p][p]– Reduced volume of NPC "UNION Technician” in Liubech solo dungeon.[/p][p][/p][p]– Added a cash reward to the story quests “Resetting the voltage”, “For the good of Liubech”, “Curfew”, “Vaccination against the Unknown”, “In Three Pines”.[/p][p][/p][p]– Increased the amount of ammo given out as a reward in almost all story missions in Liubech.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed some typos in the game texts.[/p][p][/p][p]– Changed Viktor Serebryakov's profession to the correct one: \[UNION] stockman.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue that made it impossible to complete the “Seize the contraband” quest.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed the logic of the quest “Two of a kind”, now you can talk to Mikulo about the quest at any time.[/p][p][/p][p]– Panich can take players to Vesuvius again (for the “UNION” reputation).[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed a bug with incorrect operation of the device in the “Resetting the voltage” task for English and Chinese localizations.[/p][p][/p][p]– The achievement "It's dangerous in hallways" has been moved from the hallways in Liubech to the hallways in Liubech Outskirts.[/p][p][/p][p]– Fixed an issue with filtering Premium Subscription in Account Storage.[/p][p][/p][p]– Reduced muzzle flash when firing from Steyr AUG A2 with a flashhider attached.[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]Stay Out Team[/p]

notes.title: Content Update. 15.07.25
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/b9d82640b71d64fd9ddb93250b2416794f3e4265.png"][/img][/p][p]Stalkers![/p][p][/p][p]We present you a list of changes included in today's update:[/p][p][/p][h1]Liubech[/h1][p][/p][p]– The plot and location quests have been completely reworked: almost all old quests have been removed.[/p][p][/p][p]– Old players who have already entered Liubech Outskirts can visit Liubech freely.[/p][p][/p][p]– In order to start a new Liubech storyline, you need to approach Misha Kochegarov [b](square D6-2)[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]– The location is now a PvP-free zone.
[/p][p]– A large number of visual changes to the location.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/89533a08cb51a526218b110af246400d009903e6.png[/img]
Stalkers!

We present you a list of changes included in today's update:
[h2]New launcher[/h2]
– From the moment the update is released, all five project servers will be available to all players on all platforms!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/274bc70b1a0a93e5c2b6bb089aa5c1240313efb1.png[/img]
That is, any player on any platform can now enter both the RU1-3 and EU1/US1 servers.

You no longer need to have several game clients on your PC at once — everything will be available in one place.

[b]Note!
If you have an account on the Steam platform, you can only log in to the Steam platform. The same with the VK.Play platform.[/b]

[b]In other words: if you previously played on servers RU1-3, after the update you enter your username and password in the same way and continue to play as usual.
If you played on the Steam/VK.Play platforms, click the corresponding button to log into your account.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/8aab776b42dd87480eb66e811494f3a613763c11.png[/img]
Now all users will have the opportunity to conveniently create a new account by logging in through popular platforms.

Basically, click on the icon of the platform you want and create a game account linked to your account on this platform.

List of available login platforms:
[list]
[*] Gmail
[*] Yandex
[*] VK
[*] Odnoklassniki
[*] Mail.ru
[*] Epic Games
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/c1a3c964ba8dc48f5f8c982eff88ed8bb0c19f10.png[/img]
[h2]Dynamic events[/h2]
– Dynamic events have appeared in the world of the game, which occur with a certain frequency in all locations except “Lesnaya” Station, Liubech and New Land’s Southern Is..

In the first iteration, three kinds of events will appear:
[list]
[*] Helicopter crash site;
[*] Broken old lorry;
[*] Small bandit camp.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/a7a74deeb8753d0244b693c1f4b1374b12096167.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/0ba96f0818861adf48e407b653b1b10cba4c7638.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/8e10f62a15bdfaf1dfd4f68e2a84ee4620d1d319.png[/img]
Each event has different rewards and frequency of appearance in locations.

Dynamic events activate in random places on the location. If you are nearby, you can receive notifications about an active event: the main one tells about what’s happening here, and the additional one tells you that the area in which the event is taking place has been temporarily added on the map.

[b]Penalty system.[/b]

2 match refusal: 10 minute penalty for participating in the search for the next match;

notes.title: Update. Vesuvius and the clan system.
notes.content:
​[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/d4c6fbf8f7403323c9a6c9ea5fa7ceea2b0ac9a8.png[/img]

Stalkers!

We present to you a list of changes included in today's global update:

[h2]Clans.[/h2]

– Clan level mechanics have been added:

First level of development:

The first level of group development will allow players to smoothly familiarize themselves with new mechanics in a fairly calm environment.

A first-level grouping will not be able to declare war, but it itself will not yet be able to participate in diplomacy (concluding alliances, entering and creating alliances, declaring war and peace) and battles for bases and fortifications.

Its members will also not display the name of the group and its emblem under the nickname for all other players.

The first level of development will help new players adapt to the mechanics of factions in the absence of external threats.

The first level group has access to:

Group chat

6 titles with the ability to edit them

Basic permissions available

Maximum number of group members: 10 people

We can consider that the first level of the group is an improved version of the in-game group, with a larger number of participants.

Second level of development:

Now the name and emblem of the faction will be displayed for all players

Access to the opportunity to purchase 4 more titles, bringing their total number to 10

From the second level it will be possible to participate in the capture of fortifications and bases

Declaration of war or peace to other factions will become available

A second-level group can already be invited to a union or alliance, but it itself cannot yet create one

There will be more permissions available

Limit on the maximum number of group members: 30 people

Third level of development:

It will be possible to form an alliance with another group

Additional chat tab “Union” (the tab is always displayed, but can only be used if there is an alliance)

The opportunity to participate in the auction for donation databases is available

There will be more permissions available

Limit on the maximum number of group members: 50 people

Fourth level of development:

It becomes possible to create an Alliance together with an allied group

At the 4th level of development, you can invite up to 4 groups to the Alliance

Additional chat tab “Alliance”. This tab will be available only to leaders of factions that are in the Alliance (the tab is always displayed, but it can only be used if there is an alliance)

Limit on the maximum number of group members: 110 people

Fifth level of development:

The number of factions available for invitation to the Alliance increases to 10

Limit on the maximum number of group members: 200 people

Important: if your group at the time of the update has more participants than the limit implies, the players will not be excluded from the group.

You just won’t be able to accept new participants until you reduce the current number of players below the limit.

To increase the group level, players will need Group Points, a certain amount of silver and the required number of participants.

Groups that already exist at the time of the update's release will be calibrated. You will learn about calibration further in the patch note.

– New resource - Grouping Points:

[b]Group Points are a new resource that will simultaneously serve as both a currency and an indicator of the rating of your group.[/b]

Most actions that are available to a group will now require Grouping Points (hereinafter referred to as OG).

You can earn OG in several ways:

- Capture and defense of a fortification or base

- Completing tasks from the Group Registrar

- Completing PvE and PvP tasks available only to group members from the Manager of a captured base or fortification

- Walkthrough of in-game events

What are exhaust gases spent on:

- Increasing the level of the clan
- Monthly write-off of exhaust gases. The number of OGs written off depends on the level of development of the group

- Carrying out diplomatic actions, such as concluding peace, an alliance, or creating an Alliance

- Purchasing and adding new titles

- Acquiring and improving modifications on a fortification or base

- Inviting a new player to the group

– PvE and PvP tasks for factions have been added:

Now groups will have access to individual tasks that will help them quickly gain OG, money and experience.

Tasks can be divided into two categories:

[b]PvE missions.[/b]
These quests can be obtained from NPCs involved in the factions. For example, Group Registrar, Base and Fortification Managers, and so on.

[b]PvP tasks.[/b]
Each member of the group, before capturing or defending a fortification or base, will be able to independently choose the task that he will need to complete during the capture or defense.

The player will be able to choose both the difficulty of the task and its type.

For example: kill N enemy players for the defense side, die no more than N times for the capture side, and many other tasks.

– Some powers were divided:

Top up your base account or general warehouse:
Top up your database account
Place items in the general base warehouse

Withdraw from the base or general warehouse account:
Withdraw from base account
Take items from the base's general warehouse

Declaration of war/peace:
Declaration of war
Declaration of Peace

New powers also appeared:
Write a group announcement
Change the group's motto

Depending on the level of your faction, new available powers will open up.

– Now to create a grouping you must meet some conditions:

Possess the required amount of silver to create a group (5,000,000)

Have character level 30

– Alliance mechanics have been added:

An alliance is a union of several factions, with their own alliance “tag” and one group at the head.

To create an alliance, a group must have one ally, the appropriate group level and OG.

The head of the main group of the alliance will be able to both select the displayed “tag” and invite other participants to the association.

Of course, when joining an already existing alliance, factions inherit each other's enemies.

All “tags” of factions in the alliance will be green.

All the important tactical advantages (and several new ones) that were previously available to one ally are now available to all factions in the alliance.

The benefits of being in an alliance or union:

All members of the alliance or union will be able to use the rebirth point and safe zone at all donation bases, captured bases and fortifications.

The use of warehouses and machines at captured bases will also be free.

Members of an alliance or union will be able to enter the allied donation bases and use most of its services.

Faction leaders will receive a separate chat tab for more convenient coordination of actions (the tab is always displayed, but can only be used if there is an alliance).

[h2]Rating and clan board.[/h2]

– At the location Airport (airport building), Tunguska (Radius village), Black Forest (Mitrich), Vesuvius (Radio tower), Novaya Zemlya o. Southern (Bridge) Faction Registrars have been added.

– A Group Board has appeared near all Group Registrars.

On this board you can find a rating table of factions, which will be available for review by all players on the server.

The position of the group in the ranking will be determined by the current number of earned OGs.

Once a month, on the 1st, a certain amount of OG will be debited from each group, in accordance with the level of the group.

If a group was not active enough during the month (earned less OG than the monthly write-off amount), it lowers its place in the ranking.

(For example: the monthly write-off amount is 2000 OG, but the number of OG for the group is only 1000. The total number of OG in the rating table after the write-off will be 0.

But, if you earned 2600 OG, and 2000 was written off, then you remain in the black by 600 OG.)

– Also, any player can use the faction board and get acquainted with the capture map - up-to-date information about which faction owns a fortification or base, how much time is left before the capture, which territories have not yet been captured, and which ones are currently being fought for.

Information will be displayed within the location where the player is located.

[h2]Calibration.[/h2]

As part of the calibration, which will last two months from the date of the update's release, all factions will receive a level of zero, which will provide most of the capabilities available before the global update.

Within two months from the date of the update, all factions will earn Faction Points.

The total amount of exhaust gases received during calibration will be taken into account, without taking into account their expenses.

At the end of calibration, depending on the amount of exhaust gas received, the groups will be assigned the appropriate level.

Donation bases will also be retained by the owners for the entire period of calibration.

[h2]P.K.[/h2]

– Changed the system for receiving karma:

The transition to PK status now occurs when you have 500 karma points.

Also, now the amount of karma received for killing a player depends only on the level of the location where the murder occurred:

Lyubech - 300 karma points.

Neighborhoods of Lyubech, Vesuvius, Airport - 260 karma points.

Tunguska, Novaya Zemlya (Northern and Southern Islands), Caravan - 170 karma points.

Black Forest - 125 karma points.

[h2]Capture.[/h2]

– All participants in the capture or defense will now receive experience.

– Now all players who entered the capture zone will automatically be highlighted as “enemies” for everyone, except for members of their group and members of a union or alliance. The security of bases and fortifications will also respond accordingly.

[h2]Bases and fortifications.[/h2]

– Depending on the duration (in days) of owning a base or fortification, new opportunities will gradually open up, such as:

The ability to hire “smart” security guards (example: private security company “Utyos”).

There will also be different variations of guards: sniper, patrol and guard.

All three types of guards are capable of occupying cover and firing from them at attackers.

[b]Security Guard:[/b] has average equipment and weapons.

[b]Sniper:[/b] An improved version of the guard. Features better quality uniforms and weapons.

[b]Patrolman:[/b] has the best uniform and weapons of all the available guards. Conducts patrols within the base, and is also capable of taking cover when threatened and returning to patrol.

Also, the guards can now use a knife in close combat and can throw grenades.

– Temporary rebirth points - bonfires - have appeared around bases and fortifications.

These spawn points are only available during capture.

Bonfires are activated half an hour before capture and have a small safe zone.

If you leave a safe zone, it becomes inactive until your next respawn.

– At all bases and some fortifications, it became possible to purchase and install a machine gun point. You can purchase it from the database manager.

The machine gun must be loaded with cartridges for firing.

– The ability to purchase the NPC “Provodnik” has been added to all bases and fortifications.

The guide can, for a fee, move you between bases and fortifications that are in your possession.

The conductor guides only within the location where it is installed.

– It is now possible to purchase decorative banners on which you can upload the desired image.

– The cost of modifications to bases and fortifications has been rebalanced.

[h2]Trade routes.[/h2]

– Added new faction mechanics - Trade Routes.

From this moment on, all fortifications belong to a specific settlement.

Having a base and specific fortifications in its possession, the group can “pave a trade route” between them.

If the trade route is laid correctly, the group can hire a “Factional Representative” of the settlement to which the route was laid to its base.

For example: having captured a certain number of fortifications on Vesuvius and a transition fortification in the Outskirts of Lyubech, and connecting the paths with the base in the Outskirts of Lyubech, the group can hire a representative of the “Aegis” camp and purchase a certain list of goods (equipment, consumables, injectors) for Group Trade Points and so on).

There are many representatives.

Each faction offers its own list of goods available for purchase.

The group can independently change the desired representative in the database modification window for a certain fee.

Trade points of the Group, when changing the faction of the representative, are transferred.

The affiliation of fortifications with settlements can be seen on the grouping board, as well as the connections between bases and fortifications:

White lines are all connections.

Green ones are those that belong to your group.

Orange - transitional connections between locations.

There are also transitional connections between cards. That is, having a captured base and two transition fortifications, you can, for example, in the outskirts of Lyubech, install a representative of the settlement from the Black Forest, Vesuvius, and so on.

It is important that there is a direct connection through fortifications to the base in order to be able to select a representative.

– Faction Trade Points have been added to factions.

They are needed to purchase items from faction representatives.

They work in the same way as regular Trade Points.

You can get OTG by completing tasks and going through in-game events.

[h2]Donation bases.[/h2]

– Donation bases are no longer renewed by the owners. After the end of the ownership period, the donation base again goes to auction.

– Added 3 new donation bases: Novikovo (Vesuvius, G2-1), Usov village 4 (D3-2) and Krasnoe village 4 (T9-1) (Black Forest).

[h2]Vesuvius.[/h2]

[b]Important: all characters who were at the location at the time of the update will be sent to the Lyubech station.[/b]

– Global changes to the visual component of the location.

– The size of the location has been increased by 1.5 times.

– Changed the location of the entrance to the Volcano event (E7-2).

– Some species of animals and mutants infected with spores appeared at the location.

– Added representatives of the “Ark” faction. Most of them are located in the village of Podgornaya.

– All fortifications have been removed from the location, except for the “Bridge” fortification (the fortification has been renamed and completely redone).

– Added 2 new bases and 6 fortifications. You can find out their location on the faction board.

– Camp “Aegis” is now located in the old location of DOL “Druzhba” (I4-4).

– The distillery is located on the old site of the “Aegis” and the Military Warehouse (I8-3 / I9-1).

– The polygon from the north of the map moved south - to the northern border of Vulcan and was significantly expanded (E4, E5, F4, F5, G4, G5).

– “Rowanushka” (or rather its inhabitants) now live outside the anomalous Collective Garden - on the eastern bank of the river in the territory of an abandoned construction site (A4-4, A5-2).

– DOL “Druzhba” acquired a huge recreational area (Reserve) and a lake with an equipped beach - now this recreation area is located in the southwestern part of the map (B8-2/4).

– Vanya Hell left “Novikovo” and, together with his group “Purgatory” (now quite numerous), settled in the tunnels of the mining and processing plant. On the approaches to the industrial zone of the quarry there are training areas for its newcomers.

– The radio tower has noticeably changed and moved north of its usual location, to the area of the former Test Site (E2-1/2).

[h2]Locations.[/h2]

– Visual changes to the “Tunguska” and “Caravan” locations.

– Updated visual of the PvP location “Central Library”.

– Artifacts no longer appear in the anomalies of the Usov-Swamp event.

– Access to Vesuvius through NPC Monroe no longer requires fulfillment of additional conditions for characters level 50+

[h2]Quests.[/h2]

– When you first enter the game, the reputation of the “Ark” group will be reset (since many players actively did the “Purgatory” quests and could ruin their relationship with the Ark)

– A new storyline has been added in which players are invited to take sides in the confrontation between two key factions in the location: “Purgatory” and “Ark”.

– Added 10 new reusable missions for the Purgatory group. (They can be obtained under certain circumstances from the following NPCs: Chemist, Chaplain, Leviathan, Stygian;).

– Added two new side quests for the “Purgatory” group

(They can be obtained under certain circumstances from the following NPCs: Chemist, Stygian;).

(They can be obtained from the following NPCs: Mario, Steel Chief, Nikita Sergeevich).

(Having a reputation with this group of values below zero).

Instead, completely new daily tasks and quest lines have been added.

(This is not the final version and some quest lines will be continued in the near future).

– The “Inoculation against the Unknown” quest line can now be completed.

To continue the line (who has completed all previously introduced subchapters), contact Lev Valerianovich at the Lyubech Commandant’s Office.

– Added a new line of Omega quests for Gorely and Mirny.

(You can start it in the Lyubech Commandant’s Office after completing the “Vaccination against the Unknown”).

– The Konukovo Airfield quest line has been reworked.

The line is available for completion even for those players who have previously completed Shepelev’s quests.

– A number of new daily quests have been added to the Konukovo airfield, and a competition for collecting audio cassettes has been added to Karl.

– Added the ability to move from the Airport to Vesuvius and back (Airport Dam - Aegis) - the reputation of “Omega” and “Aegis” is required, respectively. Requires completion of the Mirny quest line.

[h2]Items.[/h2]

– Now the PTT can be attached to body armor 6B1 and 6B2

[h2]Economy.[/h2]

– The cost of shots and shells in exchange for black cartridges has been changed.

[h2]Skills.[/h2]

– The “Reduce Positive Effects” skill no longer removes the effects of: Energy, Nerve Stimulator, Devil’s/Ryabinovka/Brusnikovka Injectors, Psychomotor Stimulator.

With 80% probability the skill outputs:

Antidote and antirad VOF

Treatment of intoxication

Poor treatment for radiation sickness

Average treatment for radiation sickness

Treatment of food poisoning

Cardiac muscle tone

Mutant Poison Poison Resistance

Treatment of the parasite Treatment of poisoning from mutant venom

Treatment of chemical poisoning

Treatment of nausea

– The “Grievous Wound” skill now triggers with a 50% chance

[h2]Interface.[/h2]

– Updated icons of cartridges, spare parts, repair kits, and some weapons.

– Removed short names of icons for all items.

– For more convenient identification, a tooltip for items was included in the interface.

– Added the ability to download patches in 128x128 resolution.

– Added Russian localization of settings.

– Changed the font in the in-game chat and some interfaces.

– The group now has the ability to make announcements that will be available in the main information window about the group and will be displayed in the chat of all group members when entering the game.

The player will be able to get acquainted with the card both on the global rating board and when inviting a player to a group.

– The group now has the ability to make announcements that will be available in the main information window about the group and will be displayed in the chat of all group members when entering the game.

– Trade Points are now displayed when received in the in-game chat.

[h2]Gameplay.[/h2]

– Added achievement for 30,000 karma points.

– Effects Treatment of intoxication, Weak treatment of radiation sickness, Moderate treatment of radiation sickness, Treatment of food poisoning, Resistance to poisoning from mutant poison, Treatment of parasite, Treatment of poisoning from mutant poison, Treatment of chemical poisoning, Treatment of nausea are no longer reset upon death.

[h2]Events.[/h2]

– In the “Old TV” event, the zone of PvP laws was increased.

– In the events Forgotten Suitcase, Broken Bell, Bonfire, Moskvich, Bulldozer, 5 Obelisks, Vulcan, a PvP zone was added.

[h2]PvP.[/h2]

– Now in the PvP “Sabotage” mode, in order to win the attacking side, you need to hold the button down for a certain time.

– Added the ability to create your own PvP rooms.

Players can select the desired location and make the room open/closed for entry.

– Added PvP map “Suburb of Lyubech”. You can select it when creating your own room.

– Added the ability to reconnect to a match within 60 seconds without losing points.

[h2]Anti cheat.[/h2]

– Added a reporting system for players directly inside the game. In order to report a player, you can either right-click on him and select the appropriate item, or right-click directly on the nickname in the in-game chat.

[h2]Technical changes.
[/h2]
– Multithreading support has been added in test mode. By default it is enabled for everyone. You can disable it in “Basic Settings”.

[b]– Removed x86 version of the client.[/b]

[b]– In the near future, support for operating systems Windows 7 and below will be completely discontinued.[/b]

[h2]Sound.[/h2]

– Added two new voices for NPCs

[h2]Error correction.[/h2]

– Fixed a bug where the fire in the Black Forest did not heat up (N6-4).

– Fixed additional damage from the “Catapult” anomaly

– Poisonous food now counts towards chef achievements.

– Fixed a bug when, when trying to take money from the auction of donation bases, if the maximum limit in the inventory was exceeded, they disappeared.

– Now you can withdraw money from the donation database auction only after it ends

[h2]Affiliate program and promotional code system.[/h2]

– As part of the updated Affiliate Program, any User who registers in it will receive a certain percentage in in-game currency (Platinum) from all purchases of Users who registered using his promotional code.

You can register for the Affiliate Program directly in the main menu of the game by selecting the appropriate item.

After registering in the Affiliate Program, each Affiliate will receive their own unique Promo Code consisting of random symbols.

By entering the Partner Promo Code, New Users will receive a certain bonus after registering in the project (Premium subscription and other variations).

As soon as the New User makes any purchase in the in-game store, the Partner who invited the New User and whose Promotional Code was used to register, will from that moment always receive a certain percentage of the invited User’s further purchases in the form of “Platinum”.

The user will be able to spend “Platinum” in the in-game store at his own discretion by switching the store to pay with “Platinum”.

The same products will be available for purchase as in the regular in-game store, at the same prices.

You can spend Platinum on any server. To do this, you need to log into your Affiliate Program account in another game account.

You can track the number of User replenishments, your current percentage, expenses and other information about your participation in the Affiliate Program on the website: media.stalker.so (the site will be available for entry along with the release of the update).

A New User can enter a Partner promo code on any server and any platform, be it a launcher, Steam or VK.Play.

Please note: the Partner's promotional code must be entered within 14 days from the date of registration. This option will no longer be available.

To enter a Promo Code, you must select “Enter Promo Code” in the main menu of the game and enter it in the window that appears.

[b]– Media partners:[/b]

The changes also affected interaction with our Media partners.

Now you don't have to worry about getting goods for giveaways or consumables for creating content - you can buy them yourself!

If you want to become or are already our Media Partner, for example, you cooperate with us in some way, create interesting content for our Project or already have a unique Promo Code, you can receive an increased percentage in the form of “Platinum” from all purchases of Users who will register with your Promo Code.

The media partner can also independently select the desired Promo Code.

In order to become our Media Partner, after registering in the Affiliate Program, you need to familiarize yourself with the information on the website media.stalker.so

Next, you need to contact the community manager of the project (VK: https://vk.com/staers_so / Discord: StaerS).

If you are already our Media Partner, you will automatically receive the entire amount of “Platinum” to your account for all users registered at the time of the release of the Affiliate Program.

Also, all previously registered Users who used the Media Partner Promo Code will be assigned to your Affiliate Program account.

– Added promotional code system.

From the moment of the update, during holidays and some important events, players will be able to use unique promotional codes and receive valuable bonuses for them.

You can enter a promotional code by selecting the appropriate item in the main menu of the game.

Stalkers!

Here is a list of changes that are included in today's New Year's update:

– The event will last from 22.12.22 to 23.02.23

– The contents of the “Gift” received for 1st place in active New Year PvP events have been changed.

– The minimum number of required participants in the Gingerbread Madness PvP event has been increased from 5 participants to 10.

– Rewards in Squirrels for the New Year PvP event Gingerbread Madness have been changed.

– Gingerbread's exploding candy has increased the amount of shards it explodes when it explodes.

[b]Events / Events:[/b]

– At the location of Lyubech (DK), Vicinities of Lyubech (Gourmet), Vesuvius (Radio tower) and Tunguska (Radius), barkers have returned who will send you to City N.

– Added large-scale in-game PvE event "Lost Ice".

You can get into it by talking with Vostrikov, on Novaya Zemlya, Severny Island.

In this event, the stalkers will have to organize a group and go in search of the missing expedition, find out what is really happening in those parts, what is hidden behind it and why not everyone is destined to return from there...

The event is available from level 75.

One of the rewards for the event was Frozen Coins, which will be exchanged for Black Shells in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/067c82efbc7c3e2ecfebbaee8aaf171f90123f03.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/752943ad3f800f99a170ba5145559a51c2ce06ee.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/d2fd9edb0754ecd0e0d5dee1a0585d7b65201659.png[/img]

– The logic of passing and rewards for the Usov-Marsh event has been reworked.

For completing the event, “Tickets to Usov” are now given, which the owner (having level 85) can use to go to Usov (through Mazaya) for free at any time.

– A checkpoint system has been added to the Forgotten Ice and Mustache Marsh events. After successfully completing the stages, players will receive a message about changing the spawn point. When re-entering an event, players will spawn at the last checkpoint. Once every 24 hours, the progress of events is reset.

– On Yuzhny Island of Novaya Zemlya, a mini-event is launched every 6 game hours. The beginning of the event is signaled by a tornado appearing on the mountain.

[b]Items:[/b]

– Added 2 jackets: "Stitched Hoodie" and "Jacket Ural".

You can get the Stitched Hoodie by trading Belochka Candies with Johnny in City N.

"Jacket Ural" has been added to the in-game store.

– The "L96A1" rifle can now be obtained by successfully completing the "Rite" event in the Black Forest. You need to get the "Charged Sage's Medallion" by taking 1st place and contact the mysterious person in the Military Town.

Cartridges and magazines for the rifle are sold by Huckster in the camp of Shleimovich and Plevka on Novaya Zemlya, Yuzhny Island

In the future, there will be more merchants selling ammo and magazines.

– Added "Flash hider for SIG SG552". Now with the appropriate adapter - "GEMTECH M4-96D", you can install the silencer "GEMTECH M4-96D".

The flash hider will be automatically installed on a new weapon when buying or exchanging a weapon (except for weapons that are already on hand).

Separately, it can be purchased from Vanya Hell for trade points.

– The 18-round SVD magazine will be automatically replaced with 20-round magazines.

– “Old stabilized solution” will be automatically changed to “50 ml stabilized solution”.

– Bulletproof vest "6B3" can now be painted.

– The “Many-Faced Head” for the “Rite” event can now be found with a chance after winning the “Broken Bell” event in the nearby houses of the flooded village of Starotserkovnaya.

– Reworked the location of containers with loot in the suburbs of Lyubech.

– Mushrooms now appear in the Airport location.

– The amount of ammo received in ammo crates has been increased. Also added magazines for different types of weapons and items designed to care for weapons.

– The chance to get food and water in caches has been increased.

– On Novaya Zemlya, Severny Island, now you can find caches.

– Adjusted the weight of many items.

– Fragments of unknown origin, mined in the Tunguska swamps in piles of earth, now drop on death.

[b]Weapons / Weapon Upgrades / Modifiers:[/b]

– Changed recoil pattern for Famas F1 and Famas G2.

– "SIG SG550" now loses damage when firing at long distances.

– Decreased recoil on OTs-14-1 Groza-1 and OTs-14-4 Groza-4.

– Decreased recoil on SR3 Whirlwind and SR3M.

– Reduced the brightness of the Bushnell HOLO Sight Model #50-0021 reticle.

– Reduced recoil on the M4A1.

[b]Gameplay:[/b]

– New PvP mode "Sabotage"

Try your hand at the new PvP mode, in which players will have to play for two sides of the coin: defend or attack. Sabotage a residential area by disabling the control panel, which, according to rumors, is responsible for activating the "jammers" that prevent the appearance of mutants in crowded places, or take a defensive position and prevent an attack!

Visit the "Residential District" location and do what is necessary to achieve a common goal!

This mode will be included in the rating competitions in the next PvP season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/99be85a6e5bc86adb9b88d369c896a503ac6743a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/c12bfc49defab3ccf274a7c734bc9fd50a61e191.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/2b8d0eae5d162fd39e2599e32b21179f0dacd997.jpg[/img]

– Changed the requirements and rewards in some quests when completing the "Mystery Collector" (for example, the Distillery Master requires a Simple Tool instead of a Weapon Mod Toolbox).

– The pipeline on Tunguska leading to the Tower has been rebuilt - now it will be more difficult to fall from it.

– Mazai's dialogues have been rebuilt - he adequately responds to the value of the player's reputation. The passage of the Mustache-Marsh event is no longer directly related to entering the Black Forest, as a reward for it, tickets are issued for which you can enter the Black Forest for free at any time (having level 85). Instead of money, you can pay for the transition with the “Explorer” artifact (Panych also has it).

– Killing Utyos mercenaries in the Usov-Marsh event no longer removes the reputation of PSC Utyos.

– Fixed behavior of Gena Crocodile and Valdai.

– Fixed Khromtsov's behavior - now he does not walk around the entire territory of the Prison, but stays near the area accountable to him.

– Increased rewards for the Caged Scientist quest line (Camp Aegis).

– Associate Professor Krasnov added a new quest for the extraction of "Vesuvius" (opens after receiving recipes for "Meteor")

– A quest has been added to the game to obtain a recipe for special mutant blood to activate the “Rite” event.

– A quest for obtaining the L96A1 rifle has been added to the game (for the owner of the “Charged Sage Medallion”, which can be obtained for the “Rite” event).

– Fixed the delivery of the quest "Tash and bread" at Bolotnik.

– Fixed delivery of the quest "Help without thanks".

– Fixed Tatarin’s dialogues for taking the “Reports” quest.

– Station watchman can now repair MZA.

– Vanya Hell's cost of "Old Tools" has been increased.

– Added “Benelli M4 Lid” and “Benelli M4 2-Round Lid” to Van Adu for trade points.

– An audit of all cartridges in the game at merchants and in exchanges has been made.

– Pusher now buys food and tableware.

– Weapon parts and repair kits can now be sold to gunsmiths and fences.

– The exchange of F-1 grenades with the Retired Colonel has been moved to Corkscrew.

– A new exchange has been added to the retired Colonel.

– The Colonel's trade is now available with the "Advanced Services" bonus of the Radius Village.

– Reduced the number of required bottles for the alcohol exchange in the Sly exchange.

– Increased the amount of trade points received for the Vesuvius artifact from Stepanenko.

– Added “Cowberry Decoction Recipe” to Fly Agaric in exchange. The number of Amanita mushrooms required for exchange for Amanita Tincture Recipe has been changed.

– Trader Vasily Pylnov in "Schleimovich's camp" no longer sells "Recipe for filling the injector with Energetic", instead he sells "Recipe for Vial with Energetic".

– Merchant Stepanenko in "Camp Aegis" sells "Recipe for a test tube with a nerve stimulator."

– Dispatcher now sells “Ryabinovka Tincture Recipe”, the cost of selling “Empty Bottle” for trade points has been reduced.

– Gourmet now buys "Heart of the Wolf" for trade points. The cost of selling "Verlioca Eggs" and "Boar's Heart" for trade points has been increased.

– Veterinarian now sells recipes for blood and poison of various creatures in the Zone.

– Bartender, Veterinarian, Plyushch, Metrofan, Gurman and Pivovarov buy animal parts cheaper.

– The supplier buys more expensive hunting trophies.

– Bartender now buys vegetables and parts of organs with trade points.

– Brewers buy vegetables more expensive, the cost of selling "Mutant Hog Knee" for trade points has been increased. Now he buys part of the organs for trade points.

– Metrofan buys Salo cheaper.

– Ivy buys Mutant Hog's Knee for more.

[b]Craft:[/b]

– The lost Mechanical Workbench and Soldering Station of the Mokrukha faction have been returned.

– Fixed dismantling of medicines - removed unnecessary items not involved in their creation.

– Crafting "Sterile Cloth" and "Pack of Bandages" no longer require a skill.

– Radiation Remover can now be dismantled.

[b]Mutants and Anomalies:[/b]

– Edited the location of some Draug spawn points in the Black Forest, Outcasts in Tunguska, Polar Bears in Novaya Zemlya.

– Spiders can now burrow underground and return to the spawn point after some time after losing the pursuit target.

– Some movement paths and types of animals and mutants in the outskirts of Lyubech have been reworked.

– The bear and wild boars from the canyon of the Airport location have been moved to square C5-1, the canyon is filled with the anomalies "Sparkler" and "Catapult".

– Imps (except for the slow one) can now find BS ammo instead of AP.

– The number of Polar Wolves on Novaya Zemlya on Severny Island has been corrected.

– The chance of obtaining “Mutant Hog Knees” when butchering “Mutant Hog” has been increased.

– Reduced the gravity of the Crusher anomalies.

– Changes in the western and southern parts of the Black Forest:

Species, population and ways of movement of mutants and animals have been changed.

Increased the number and changed types of anomalies.

Increased the number of mushrooms and herbs.

Increased the time between spawns of Mutant Hogs.

[b]Sound:[/b]

– Added inventory sounds

– Added sounds for soldering and laboratory workbenches

[b]Interface:[/b]

– Changed bulletin board interface.

[b]Achievements:[/b]

– Added achievements for completing the Forgotten Ice event.

[b]In-game store:[/b]

– Some items in the in-game store now have the "Guarantors" system.

Items covered by this system are marked in green.

How it works?

In the description of these products, it is indicated that in one of the N-number of openings, you are guaranteed to receive an item or one of the items within the specified group.

[b]Optimization:[/b]

– Optimized textures.

– To improve optimization, the passage to the storekeeper in Gourmet Village has been modified.

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]

– Fixed English localization of many items.

– Fixed a bug when, when respawning, the player appeared not at the last faction respawn, but at other locations. For example, at the railway station in Lyubech.

Sincerely,
SO team

notes.title: Developers Diares. New Perk Tree
notes.content:
More than a year has passed since we told our group in vk that the pumping system will be completely redesigned. It's time to talk more substantively and reveal some details.
We have tried to answer some of the most common questions you asked in today's Dev Diaries.

[i][b]Please note that the changes described below are in the works, may change and are not the final version.[/b][/i]

[b] What will happen after the release of the upgrade? [/b]

After the release of the update, all the experience gained by the players (survival, support, combat) will be summed up, the old perks and tabs will be removed, and a "perk tree" will appear in their place. Based on the accrued experience, the player will be given a level and the corresponding number of skill points. At the moment, the maximum level is 150, while even with the old pumping 30/30/30, players will have a wide scope for improvement, and they will be able to continue to gain experience by increasing their level. We will provide the exact ratio of old levels to new ones a little later. Experience gain will remain the same, but will be balanced across locations, including mechanics and quests. The deeper you go into the zone, the stronger the opponents will become and the more difficult the quests for which you will gain more experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/2f24f2758390d5e55cd7b3b652b14ce33a6a4760.png[/img]

As the level rises, the player will receive skill points, which he can invest in the perks that interest him. Each perk costs a certain number of skill points, while some perks will cost more than others, since they provide a significant bonus, and some will be available for study only after certain conditions are met. You will not be able to study absolutely all perks - skill points will be enough for half. At the same time, if a player wants to change his set of perks, he can discard them (once for free, in the future you will have to pay a certain price).

At the very beginning, the player will have access to the main “inner ring” - the basic perks that must be learned in order to unlock the entire skill tree, after which it will be possible to start your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/bff69a2fa18fd3430596540089bc1955a320a52f.png[/img]

The skill tree is divided into 6 branches: Weapons, Hunting, Crafting, Medicine, Survival, Stalker. Each branch has its own directions.

An example of the Medicine branch:

[list]
[*] the player can specialize as a combat medic, effectively helping his teammates on the battlefield
[*] can improve their skills of crafting medicines
[*] can better assimilate medications on itself and effectively fight against dangerous environmental factors, pumping additional Survival
[/list]

Example of a Craft branch:

[list]
[*] the player can specialize in repairing armor, cleaning or improving weapons
[*] improve the skills of crafting equipment
[*] improve your medicine crafting skills
[/list]

Some branches will depend on each other. For example, if you want to improve the craft of medicine to the maximum, then you will need to pump both Craft and Medicine, that is, if you do not start to pump Craft, then the crafting of complex medicines will not be available. Or, for example, if you want to more effectively fight the diseases and dangerous entities of the zone, then you need to pump Survival and Medicine. There is no need to worry about recipes that have already been learned by the players - they will not be deleted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/d730932dd37482b6bed46495243e5ddb4a3f6dfb.png[/img]

The player himself chooses how to pump perks and what role he will play, based on his style of play. At the same time, the choice of a branch will not impose restrictions on the use of weapons, armor, devices and other items (with the exception of machines for creating items). Each branch has perks that open up new mechanics, such as holding your breath, crafting medications, improving weapons, full-fledged cooking on a fire with a pot, accelerated healing of yourself, accelerated resuscitation of an unconscious player with the ability to regain lost positive effects or reanimate without a serious wound. butchering mutants with the extraction of rare parts, increasing the visibility range of caches and boxes, fast loading of magazines.

When creating a pumping, we wanted to achieve the maximum possible variability and depth of gameplay, to make the player's choice something really important and interesting on the way of becoming his character. The system will definitely undergo deep testing and we will be glad to hear your suggestions on its account.

That's all for today. In the next issues we will continue to introduce you to the innovations!

notes.content:
Added 22.12.2020

Ivan Hell now gives less personal credits for SPAS-12, USAS 12 and Benelli M4, as their current value does not match their prevalence in the Zone.

[b]New Year![/b]

N-Town, Gingerbread madness and all New Year's activities are back!

Talk to the barkers who are in the Gourmet village, on the Radio Tower, near the Lubech Palace of Culture or in the Radius village to go to N-Town, where this year New Year's stalker adventures, old friends and new unexpected turns of history await you.

This year, the Gingerbread Madness event has got new opportunities. Now elves can come to the aid of the Gingerbread Monster! To take part in the event, go to the board in N-Town.

And, of course, Johnny's new awards await you this year!

[b]The zone is getting more dangerous.[/b]

The further the stalker goes to the Zone, the more inhospitable and dangerous the environment becomes, the mutants are angrier, and the anomalies are more fatal. However, whoever answers the Zone challenge and survives will be rewarded. It is this concept of the Zone that seems to us the most correct, and in order to operate effectively in the depths of the Zone, a stalker needs to acquire advanced skills, improve his equipment and train his personal "skill".

Following this development logic, we have decided to make such remote areas of the Zone as the Caravan and Novaya Zemlya noticeably more dangerous and more demanding in terms of skills and equipment.

In the depths of the Zone there is a vast area called "Caravan", known for rare artifacts and valuable prey from mutants. Having not lost in number, but becoming noticeably stronger and more dangerous, the mutant hogs have now evenly settled in the Caravan and roam it at night, surrounded by their younger relatives. Now they are truly able to challenge the most experienced hunters. However, stalkers who know their weaknesses and are able to pierce their thick skin from their weapons will receive a valuable reward and a large amount of combat experience.

Another attractive place for stalkers in the depths of the Zone: small islands in the north of Novaya Zemlya. It is known that they are valuable for numerous archaeological finds. Recently, there has been an increased anomalous activity, due to which the archaeologist Arkady Rzhavyy is forced to look for desperate daredevils who are ready to face new difficulties and bring him ancient fossils.

The super mutant, known among stalkers as Spider-khan, also became more tenacious, as befits a real "boss" among the creatures of the Zone. Now, to emerge victorious from the fight with him, you need a well-trained and experienced team. Well, or the help of the "Spider Killer".

[b]The result of any activity must be in demand[/b]

Whatever the stalker does in the Zone, be it hunting, war, gathering, completing quests or crafting, the result should be new game possibilities. If a stalker is engaged in hunting or gathering, his prey is parts of mutants and objects, and he should be able to exchange this loot for equipment or some services of interest to him.

Following this logic, in the current update, we have not only significantly expanded the range of goods traded for Trade Points by the NPC Supplier, but also significantly increased the range of mutant parts for which he is ready to give these Trade Points. Now hunting for almost any representative of the fauna of the Zone gives access to special goods of the Supplier, if, of course, you bring the loot to him. In order to balance the new opportunities, we have slightly reduced the purchase prices at which the Supplier accepts the loot, and now it is similar to the price of most other traders.

And his goods deserve attention: these are all types of shotguns, attachments for them, scopes and silencers for most weapon models. In addition, for the Hog's Lap, mined at the Caravan, he is ready to offer a profitable exchange for zinc and boxes with the most valuable and rare cartridges.

In line with these changes, Pushkin, the gunsmith from the bar under the Distillery, is now ready to sell players a more serious barrel, namely the M16A1. And the Gourmet buys up many parts of the mutants for Trade Points that were not of interest to him before. Separately, we note that in the new reputation system being developed now, Gourmet Trade Points will be extended to trade offers of all merchants who have settled in the settlement where he prepares his "gourmet" dishes.

[b]Smoothbore weapons[/b]

We strive to add value to each weapon type. Of course, the strongest will remain in the game, but it will not be able to cover all the needs of the stalker during survival in the Zone.
In this update, we have give meaning to shotguns:
[list]
[*] increased outgoing damage with all types of cartridges (12x70 0000, 12x70 bullet, 12x76 00, 12x76 0000, 12x76 bullet from 30 to 50% depending on the specific cartridge);
[*] adjusted the damage in such a way that the greatest was dealt close (up to 3-5) and decreased in direct proportion to the distance to the target.
[*] penetration has not changed
[/list]

[b]Bulletin Board[/b]
We are closely monitoring the state of the in-game economy. The current commission for trades on the board has ceased to correspond to prices, so we have changed its size.
Now, if the transaction amount is:
[list]
[*] 0-1 million rubles - the commission will be 5%;
[*] 1-50 million rubles - 4%;
[*] more than 50 million rubles - 3%.
[/list]

[b]NPC and Quests.[/b]

[list]
[*] Story quests can now be taken even if the quest list is full.
[*] Reworked a number of quests for PvP locations.
[*] Reduced the price for which NPCs buy grenades and ammo from players.
[*] Ivan Hell’s assortment has been expanded with SIG and AUG magazines with a capacity of 30 rounds.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the line of quests "Vaccine: additional payment for vaccination?" could get stuck if you canceled this quest without completing it to the end, but completing a number of secondary quests associated with it. Previously completed secondary quests (for example, "Vaccine: Alpha Males") will now be counted on a second run - just talk to the NPCs you need.
[*] For those who canceled, but still want to try to re-pass the quest "Hucksters CH: talk to Shtaket", a new quest has been added, which is counted during the passage. Talk to Sanka Experienced.
[*] The quest "Swamp's Chronicle" is completely removed from the game.
[*] Fixed a bug with “empty” tasks for PVP arenas and incorrect descriptions. Changed the requirements for a number of quests on the number of deaths, murders, and others.
[*] The quest "Invisible Sweater" can now be taken again.
[*] Fixed some bugs with the tasks "Experiments and Consequences: Find the Commandant", "Experiments and Consequences: Courier Delivery". If you have previously had problems with them, try talking to the Greek and Kolya Acid.
[/list]

[b]Environment and locations[/b]

[list]
[*] It has become more difficult to kill boars and hogs on the caravan, while more experience is being awarded for them.
[*] Small hogs have appeared on the caravan, there will be much more of them than ordinary mutant hogs.

notes.title: New Spider-Khan cave, Lubech and PvP seasons

[b]NEW SPIDER-KHAN CAVE[/b]

In the northern part of the Lubech’s Suburbs there are a number of natural caves, which probably became part of the mysterious experiment of scientists from the “Science Laboratory”. Now there, behind a thick metal door, a gigantic spider dwells - the “zero specimen," as scientists call it. A creature that should not have appeared, and whose connection with the events in the Lubech’s Suburbs is still not completely clear. It is difficult to find a more dangerous place in this region and take risks, because only a well-armed and trained group can go down there.

Spider Khan’s Cave was redesigned and now divided into two parts, one of which has remained virtually unchanged, and the second is a dungeon designed for 5 people. Khan himself, now is only inside the dungeon. Moreover, in order to enter the players must be in the squad (at least two). The entrance to the updated cave is on the left, immediately after entering the “classic” cave.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/38f41bf80d57bac779f3118f0ddb2f7489e26da2.jpg[/img]

For passing the encounters of the dungeon, the stalkers automatically receive “Black Sleeves”, which they can exchange for various valuable items from the Specialist, which can be found in the Neighborhoods of Lubech (near the White Village), Airport (near the money changer), Radius village and on the Radio Tower.

Note! If you do not pass the dungeon from the beginning (for example, you joined the group already on Paukan), then the sleeve for the third boss is not awarded.

In addition, players always gain experience and valuable loot for completing the dungeon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/74623660374632d1c60806d97fd1046c45d4ae9b.jpg[/img]

Players holding a “Volcano Keeper’s Head” will find that it is now called “Damaged Volcano Keeper’s Head”. You can also give it to Vanya Hell, or fix it at Mitka that on Radius and take it to the Khan’s Cave to become participants in a special event and, if successful, get additional loot.

If you have failed, you can continue through the dungeon, progress (including successful completion) is reset every day at 7:00 (CET for EU  and EST for US).

If you join a group that has already passed one or two stages, you will receive a reward only for the stages you completed, while in order to receive a reward for complete completion you still need to go through all the stages. Progress is considered the leader of the group.

If you leave the group - you teleport to the entrance to the dungeon.

notes.content:
[b]Game mechanics and Items.[/b]
[list][*] The “Firearms” defence has been removed from game and replaced with the “Sturginess”
[*] All bullets have balanced damage.
[*] Each weapon in the game now has its own influence on the final penetration rate. That is, the damage, for example, caused by a 5.45 bullet fired from ak74u and ak74m on a target with armor will differ. Including, depending on which bulletproof vest is being fired. The higher the durability of the target, the greater the differences in the values of the resulting damage.
[*] The description of all cartridges will now indicate their “penetration” rate and damage (under ideal conditions, when firing at an unprotected body at point blank range, excluding buffs and armor of the attacked).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091145/22f88097d109f218847d3c0c137bd0aaaa7fb509.png[/img]
[list][*] Now, if the value of the “sturdiness” indicator is at the same level as the total “penetration” (for example, 200 versus 200), then the damage is “cut”, only by half. The maximum damage value can be obtained if the total “penetration” is higher than “sturdiness” by 100 units. (cartridge 200, armor 100), and the minimum, if less by 100 units. (i.e. cartridge 100, armor 200). Thus, the minimum possible damage (20-30% of the initial damage, depending on the cartridge) will be applied in any case.
[*] Weapons with the best characteristics, such as AK 107, SIG 550, FN-FAL, AK109 and so on, were balanced in terms of damage. Thus, we want to achieve a balance among the top weapons so that the players have a choice based on their preferences and style of play.
[*] Improved efficiency (impact on penetration) of sniper rifles, and also changed the recoil of SVD and WA-2000
[*] The Shield artifact now does not reduce damage done, but gives sturdiness to the entire body. The higher the level of the artifact, the higher the sturdiness (the effect in this case is applied to the entire body of the character) and the lifetime of the artifact. The use of “shields” will make your body armor and armor helmet more effective, because the effect of strength will be summed up
[*] Changed the number of maximum health reserves that the “pillow” artifact gives (maximum 75 with 5 equipped). In addition, they removed the debuff on movement speed when used, and the duration of the artifacts is increased depending on their level.

notes.title: New capture point and closing of N-Town
notes.content:
[b]Closing of N-Town[/b]

N-Town says goodbye to the Stalkers until next year.

[b]New Capture point [/b]
The road leading to the Airport has always been a strategic target for various groups within the Zone. Control over it is of great importance and allows you to speak on equal terms with influential figures in the Zone, for example, with the Retired Colonel. However, it is not enough to capture this point near Firestation and place your people there. It is necessary to clean the territory and find a common language with local hucksters and people from the airfield, thereby proving their strength and seriousness of intentions. And this will bear fruit by raising the status of a group capable of carrying out this kind of business.

A new capture point at “v. Krasnoe”, the capture of which begins at 19-30 Moscow time.

In addition, a number of quests have been added, available to the owners of the new fortification, as well as their allies. We plan to develop a quest system based on groupings and fortifications in future updates.

We also ask you to send information about such errors to technical support if you encounter them.
